title: Localize model guidance and lifecycle state
context: ModelsScreen has useful Vietnamese model-selection guidance, but its cards lack English catalog values. Lifecycle status is assembled into a String, which bypasses localization and shows raw uppercase engine states in Vietnamese mode.
goal: Localize model guidance and action labels, and render lifecycle state names through SwiftUI localization while preserving progress and failure details.
forbidden_changes: Do not change GGUF import, load/unload, inference, or engine lifecycle semantics.
Do not hide failure reasons or progress percentages.
Do not alter model storage or delete behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Model guidance titles and details have English and Vietnamese catalog entries.
Lifecycle labels UNLOADED, LOADING, LOADED, UNLOADING and FAILED resolve through the selected language.
Dynamic loading percentage and failure reason remain visible.
No duplicate localization keys are introduced.
verification: Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA workflow
Static duplicate-key scan for both localization catalogs
recovery: Revert the single task commit if localization or model lifecycle UI regresses.
